description: Local image and video generation runtime for Apple Silicon and MLX: one mlxgen command and Python API for text-to-image, image editing, text-to-video and image-to-video (Qwen Image, FLUX.2 Klein, Z-Image, ERNIE Image, FIBO, Wan2.2, MiniMax-H3 with audio, Bernini), SeedVR2 and SwiftVR upscaling, quantized model packages, LoRA, capabilities and progress callbacks.
